title: Create quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks

statement.en: Apply the documented Home Screen quick actions guidance to create quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks.
statement.ja: 「Home Screen quick actions」において「Create quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.
